extraction_notes: P-channel electrical quantities retain the datasheet signs: VDS, VGS, ID, VGS(th), BVDSS, and VSD are negative where published; capacitance and resistance values remain positive.

RDS(on) is published as maximum values of 0.060 ohm at VGS = -10 V and ID = -4.1 A, and 0.087 ohm at VGS = -4.5 V and ID = -3.0 A. The pulse-test footnote is pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.
The threshold row publishes MIN = -1 V and MAX = -3 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA; no typical threshold value is published.
Ciss = 700 pF, Coss = 120 pF, and Crss = 75 pF are typical values at VDS = -15 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz; Note 2 says these parameters have no way to verify.
IDSS is limited to -1 uA at VDS = -24 V and VGS = 0 V. IGSS is limited to +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-20 V and VDS = 0 V. These leakage fields are not present in the strict MOSFET schema.

The absolute-maximum table gives VDS = -30 V, VGS = +/-20 V, continuous ID = -4.1 A, PD = 0.35 W, TJ = 150 degC, RthetaJA = 357 K/W, and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. Unsupported absolute-maximum fields are not added to the strict schema.

Transfer, on-region, capacitance, and body-diode curve points are compact direct readings of the supplied typical plots on pages 3-4. No points were added by interpolation between unmarked source data.
The supplied datasheet does not state a revision, gate resistance, or body-diode reverse-recovery specification.
